1. While seated, bend forward to hug your thighs from underneath with both arms.
2. Keep your knees together and your legs extended out as you bring your chest down to your knees. You can also stretch your middle back by pulling your back away from your knees as your hugging them.
1. Clasp fingers together with your thumbs pointing down, round your shoulders as you reach your hands forward.

technical.ejecucion_es: De pie con la barra delante de los muslos y agarre algo más estrecho que los hombros. Subir la barra pegada al cuerpo, con los codos por delante, hasta la altura del pecho y bajar controlando.
technical.ejecucion_en: Stand holding the bar in front of the thighs with a grip slightly narrower than the shoulders. Lift the bar close to the body, elbows leading, to chest height, then lower under control.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Agarre más abierto y no subir por encima del pecho reducen el riesgo para el hombro.
technical.recomendaciones_en: A wider grip and not lifting above the chest reduce shoulder risk.
technical.errores_es: Agarre muy cerrado subiendo hasta la barbilla; balancear el tronco.
technical.errores_en: A very narrow grip pulling to the chin; swinging the torso.
technical.precauciones_es: Evitar si hay dolor de hombro al elevar el brazo.
technical.precauciones_en: Avoid if raising the arm is painful.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Grasp a barbell with an overhand grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The bar should be resting on the top of your thighs with your arms extended and a slight bend in your elbows. Your back should also be straight. This will be your starting position.
2. Now exhale and use the sides of your shoulders to lift the bar, raising your elbows up and to the side. Keep the bar close to your body as you raise it. Continue to lift the bar until it nearly touches your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion, and should always be higher than your forearms. Remember to keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
3. Lower the bar back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
4. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

technical.ejecucion_es: De pie frente a la polea baja con una barra, agarre algo más cerrado que los hombros. Tirar de la barra hacia arriba pegada al cuerpo, con los codos por delante, hasta la altura del pecho, y bajar controlando.
technical.ejecucion_en: Stand facing a low pulley holding a bar, grip slightly narrower than shoulder width. Pull the bar up close to the body, elbows leading, to chest height, then lower under control.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Un agarre algo más abierto y subir solo hasta la altura del pecho reducen el estrés sobre el hombro.
technical.recomendaciones_en: A slightly wider grip and stopping at chest height reduce shoulder stress.
technical.errores_es: Subir la barra hasta la barbilla con agarre muy cerrado; balancear el tronco.
technical.errores_en: Pulling to the chin with a very narrow grip; swinging the torso.
technical.precauciones_es: Puede provocar pinzamiento subacromial: evitar si hay dolor de hombro al elevar el brazo.
technical.precauciones_en: Can provoke subacromial impingement: avoid if raising the arm is painful.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Grasp a straight bar cable attachment that is attached to a low pulley with a pronated (palms facing your thighs) grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The bar should be resting on top of your thighs. Your arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and your back should be straight. This will be your starting position.
2. Use your side shoulders to lift the cable bar as you exhale. The bar should be close to the body as you move it up. Continue to lift it until it nearly touches your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the bar, your elbows should always be higher than your forearms. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
3. Lower the bar back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
4. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

1. To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. Grasp the handles using a pronated (palms facing your thighs) grip that is slightly less than shoulder width. The handles should be resting on top of your thighs. Your arms should be extended with a slight bend at the elbows and your back should be straight. This will be your starting position.
2. Use your side shoulders to lift the handles as you exhale. The handles should be close to the body as you move them up. Continue to lift the handles until they nearly touches your chin. Tip: Your elbows should drive the motion. As you lift the handles, your elbows should always be higher than your forearms. Also, keep your torso stationary and pause for a second at the top of the movement.
3. Lower the handles back down slowly to the starting position. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
4. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

1. Extend both hands straight above your head, palms touching.
2. Slowly push your hands up and back, keeping your back straight.

technical.ejecucion_es: Jalón con el agarre en V (agarre neutro y cerrado). Tirar hasta la parte alta del pecho con el tronco ligeramente inclinado atrás y subir controlando.
technical.ejecucion_en: A pulldown with the V-handle (close neutral grip). Pull to the upper chest with the torso slightly reclined and return under control.
technical.recomendaciones_es: El agarre neutro suele ser cómodo para hombros y codos.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The neutral grip is usually comfortable for the shoulders and elbows.
technical.errores_es: Inclinarse demasiado atrás; tirar con los brazos.
technical.errores_en: Leaning back too far; pulling with the arms.
technical.precauciones_en: None specific.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Sit down on a pull-down machine with a V-Bar attached to the top pulley.
2. Adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.
3. Grab the V-bar with the palms facing each other (a neutral grip). Stick your chest out and lean yourself back slightly (around 30-degrees) in order to better engage the lats. This will be your starting position.
4. Using your lats, pull the bar down as you squeeze your shoulder blades. Continue until your chest nearly touches the V-bar. Exhale as you execute this motion. Tip: Keep the torso stationary throughout the movement.
5. After a second hold on the contracted position, slowly bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe in.
6. Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions.

1. Start by placing the middle of the V-bar in the middle of the pull-up bar (assuming that the pull-up station you are using does not have neutral grip handles). The V-Bar handles will be facing down so that you can hang from the pull-up bar through the use of the handles.
2. Once you securely place the V-bar, take a hold of the bar from each side and hang from it. Stick your chest out and lean yourself back slightly in order to better engage the lats. This will be your starting position.
3. Using your lats, pull your torso up while leaning your head back slightly so that you do not hit yourself with the chin-up bar. Continue until your chest nearly touches the V-bar. Exhale as you execute this motion.
4. After a second hold on the contracted position, slowly lower your body back to the starting position as you breathe in.
5. Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions.

1. Allow the dumbbell to hang at arms length between your legs, holding it with both hands. Keep your back straight and your head up.
2. Swing the dumbbell between your legs, flexing at the hips and bending the knees slightly.
3. Powerfully reverse the motion by extending at the hips, knees, and ankles to propel yourself upward, swinging the dumbell over your head.
4. As you land, absorb the impact through your legs and draw the dumbbell to your torso before the next repetition.

technical.ejecucion_es: Caminar en cinta a la velocidad e inclinación marcadas.
technical.ejecucion_en: Walk on the treadmill at the set speed and incline.
technical.recomendaciones_es: La inclinación aumenta la intensidad sin impacto. Evitar agarrarse a la cinta.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Incline raises intensity without impact. Avoid holding the rails.
technical.errores_es: Sujetarse a las barras.
technical.errores_en: Holding the handrails.
technical.precauciones_en: None specific.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. To begin, step onto the treadmill and select the desired option from the menu. Most treadmills have a manual setting, or you can select a program to run. Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout.
2. Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, and usually have less impact than walking outside. When walking, you should move at a moderate to fast pace, not a leisurely one. Being an activity of lower intensity, walking doesn't burn as many calories as some other activities, but still provides great benefit. A 150 lb person will burn about 175 calories walking 4 miles per hour for 30 minutes, compared to 450 calories running twice as fast. Maintain proper posture as you walk, and only hold onto the handles when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking your heart rate.

1. To begin, lie down on an exercise ball with your torso pressing against the ball and parallel to the floor. The ball of your feet should be pressed against the floor to help keep you balanced. Place a weighted plate under your chin or behind your neck. This is the starting position.
2. Slowly raise your torso up by bending at the waist and lower back. Remember to exhale during this movement.
3. Hold the contraction on your lower back for a second and lower your torso back down to the starting position while inhaling.
4. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions prescribed in your program.

1. To begin, lie down on an exercise ball with your left side of the torso (waist, hips and shoulder) pressed against the ball.
2. Your feet should be on the floor while your legs are crossed and hanging from the ball. Hold a weighted plate with your right hand directly to the right side of your head. Tip: Make sure the smooth side of the plate is resting against your head.
3. Place your left arm across your torso so that your palm is on your obliques. There should be a right angle between your left forearm and upper arm. This is the starting position.
4. Raise the side of your torso up by laterally flexing at the waist while exhaling.
5. Hold the contraction for a second and slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position while inhaling.
6. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
7. Switch sides and repeat the exercise.

technical.ejecucion_es: Fondos en banco con los pies sobre otro banco y un disco sobre los muslos.
technical.ejecucion_en: Bench dips with the feet on another bench and a plate on the thighs.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Registrar la carga añadida.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Log the added load.
technical.errores_es: Bajar en exceso; carga inestable.
technical.errores_en: Going too deep; unstable load.
technical.precauciones_es: Mismas que los fondos en banco, acentuadas por la carga.
technical.precauciones_en: Same as bench dips, magnified by the load.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. For this exercise you will need to place a bench behind your back and another one in front of you. With the benches perpendicular to your body, hold on to one bench on its edge with the hands close to your body, separated at shoulder width. Your arms should be fully extended.
2. The legs will be extended forward on top of the other bench. Your legs should be parallel to the floor while your torso is to be perpendicular to the floor. Have your partner place the dumbbell on your lap. Note: This exercise is best performed with a partner as placing the weight on your lap can be challenging and cause injury without assistance. This will be your starting position.
3. Slowly lower your body as you inhale by bending at the elbows until you lower yourself far enough to where there is an angle slightly smaller than 90 degrees between the upper arm and the forearm. Tip: Keep the elbows as close as possible throughout the movement. Forearms should always be pointing down.
4. Using your triceps to bring your torso up again, lift yourself back to the starting position while exhaling.
5. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

1. Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.
2. Hold a weight to your chest, or you may hold it extended above your torso. This will be your starting position.
3. Now, exhale and slowly begin to roll your shoulders off the floor. Your shoulders should come up off the floor about 4 inches while your lower back remains on the floor.
4. At the top of the movement, flex your abdominals and hold for a brief pause.
5. Then inhale and slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.

1. Position a lightly loaded barbell across the back of your shoulders. You could also use a weighted vest, sandbag, or other type of resistance for this exercise.
2. The weight should be light enough that it doesn't slow you down significantly. Your feet should be just outside of shoulder width with your head and chest up. This will be your starting position.
3. Using a countermovement, squat partially down and immediately reverse your direction to explode off of the ground, extending through your hips, knees, and ankles. Maintain good posture throughout the jump.
4. As you return to the ground, absorb the impact through your legs.

technical.ejecucion_es: Dominada estricta con carga añadida (cinturón de lastre, chaleco o mancuerna entre las piernas).
technical.ejecucion_en: A strict pull-up with added load (dip belt, vest or a dumbbell between the legs).
technical.recomendaciones_es: Registrar el lastre: el tonelaje es peso corporal más lastre. Mantener la misma técnica que sin carga.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Log the added load: tonnage is body weight plus load. Keep the same technique as unweighted.
technical.errores_es: Recortar el recorrido; balancear la carga.
technical.errores_en: Cutting the range of motion; letting the load swing.
technical.precauciones_es: Progresión gradual; con cargas altas, cuidar codos y hombros.
technical.precauciones_en: Progress gradually; with heavy loads look after the elbows and shoulders.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Attach a weight to a dip belt and secure it around your waist. Grab the pull-up bar with the palms of your hands facing forward. For a medium grip, your hands should be spaced at shoulder width. Both arms should be extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip.
2. You'll want to bring your torso back about 30 degrees while creating a curvature in your lower back and sticking your chest out. This will be your starting position.
3. Now, exhale and pull your torso up until your head is above your hands. Concentrate on squeezing yourshoulder blades back and down as you reach the top contracted position.
4. After a brief moment at the top contracted position, inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position with your arms extended and your lats fully stretched.

technical.ejecucion_es: De pie sujetándose a un soporte, inclinar el tronco atrás mientras las rodillas avanzan y los talones se elevan, bajando con el cuerpo en línea de rodillas a hombros; volver. Carga en el pecho.
technical.ejecucion_en: Standing while holding a support, lean the torso back as the knees travel forward and the heels lift, lowering with the body in a line from knees to shoulders; return. Load held at the chest.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Aísla el cuádriceps en posición estirada. Empezar sin carga.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Isolates the quads in a stretched position. Start unloaded.
technical.errores_es: Flexionar la cadera; bajar sin control.
technical.errores_en: Bending at the hips; lowering without control.
technical.precauciones_es: Gran carga sobre la rodilla: progresar con cuidado y evitar con dolor rotuliano.
technical.precauciones_en: High knee load: progress carefully and avoid with patellar pain.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Standing upright, with feet at shoulder width and toes raised, use one hand to hold onto the beams of a squat rack and the opposite arm to hold a plate on top of your chest. This is your starting position.
2. As you use one arm to hold yourself, bend at the knees and slowly lower your torso toward the ground by bringing your pelvis and knees forward. Inhale as you go down and stop when your upper and lower legs almost create a 90-degree angle. Hold the stretch position for a second.
3. After your one second hold, use your thigh muscles to bring your torso back up to the starting position. Exhale as you move up.
4. Repeat for the recommended amount of times.

1. Start out by strapping the bands around the base of the decline bench. Place the handles towards the inside of the decline bench so that when lying down, you can reach for both of them.
2. Position your legs through the decline machine until they are secured. Now reach for the exercise bands with both hands. Use a pronated (palms forward) grip to grasp the handles. Position them near your collar bone and rotate your wrist to a neutral grip (palms facing the torso). Note: Your arms should remain stationary throughout the exercise. This is the starting position.
3. Move your torso upward until your upper body is perpendicular to the floor while exhaling. Hold the contraction for a second and lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling.
4. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

1. Start by positioning two flat benches shoulder width apart from each other. Stand on top of them and wrap the weighted belt around your waist with the amount of weight you feel comfortable with. Make sure your toes are facing out.
2. Once you are standing straight up with the weight hanging in between your legs, position your arms so that they are fully extended to the side of your body. This is the starting position.
3. Begin by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that are perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
4. Begin to move the body back up by pushing the floor of the flat bench with the ball of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position. Exhale as you perform this portion of the exercise.
5. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

technical.nombre_es: Press de banca con barra, agarre abierto
technical.ejecucion_es: Press de banca con un agarre claramente más abierto que el estándar (antebrazos algo inclinados hacia fuera abajo). Bajar la barra a la parte media del pecho y empujar.
technical.ejecucion_en: A bench press with a grip clearly wider than standard (forearms tilted slightly outward at the bottom). Lower the bar to the mid-chest and press.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Acorta el recorrido y aumenta la participación del pecho. Mantener escápulas retraídas y pies firmes.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Shortens the range of motion and increases chest involvement. Keep the shoulder blades retracted and the feet planted.
technical.errores_es: Agarre tan abierto que el hombro queda inestable; rebotar en el pecho; despegar los glúteos.
technical.errores_en: A grip so wide the shoulder becomes unstable; bouncing off the chest; lifting the glutes.
technical.precauciones_es: Mayor estrés en el hombro que el agarre medio. Usar topes de seguridad o un compañero con cargas altas.
technical.precauciones_en: More shoulder stress than the medium grip. Use safety pins or a spotter with heavy loads.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Lie back on a flat bench with feet firm on the floor. Using a wide, pronated (palms forward) grip that is around 3 inches away from shoulder width (for each hand), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. The bar will be perpendicular to the torso and the floor. This will be your starting position.
2. As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest.
3. After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
4. Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

technical.nombre_es: Press de banca declinado con barra, agarre abierto
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Lie back on a decline bench with the feet securely locked at the front of the bench. Using a wide, pronated (palms forward) grip that is around 3 inches away from shoulder width (for each hand), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. The bar will be perpendicular to the torso and the floor. This will be your starting position.
2. As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your lower chest.
3. After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
4. Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

technical.nombre_es: Pullover declinado con barra, agarre abierto
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Lie down on a decline bench with both legs securely locked in position. Reach for the barbell behind the head using a pronated grip (palms facing out). Make sure to grab the barbell wider than shoulder width apart for this exercise. Slowly lift the barbell up from the floor by using your arms.
2. When positioned properly, your arms should be fully extended and perpendicular to the floor. This is the starting position.
3. Begin by moving the barbell back down in a semicircular motion as if you were going to place it on the floor, but instead, stop when the arms are parallel to the floor. Tip: Keep the arms fully extended at all times. The movement should only happen at the shoulder joint. Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
4. Now bring the barbell up while exhaling until you are back at the starting position. Remember to keep full control of the barbell at all times.
5. Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.
6. When finished with your set, slowly lower the barbell back down until it is level with your head and release it.

technical.ejecucion_es: Sentado en la máquina con los muslos sujetos, agarre prono abierto en la barra. Inclinar ligeramente el tronco atrás y tirar de la barra hasta la parte alta del pecho llevando los codos abajo y atrás; subir controlando hasta extender los brazos.
technical.ejecucion_en: Sit in the machine with the thighs secured, holding the bar with a wide overhand grip. Lean back slightly and pull the bar to the upper chest by driving the elbows down and back; return under control to straight arms.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Pensar en llevar los codos a los bolsillos. Arriba, dejar subir los hombros para estirar el dorsal.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Think about driving the elbows into your back pockets. At the top, let the shoulders rise to stretch the lats.
technical.errores_es: Echarse muy atrás convirtiéndolo en remo; bajar la barra tras la nuca; tirar con impulso.
technical.errores_en: Leaning back so far it becomes a row; pulling behind the neck; using momentum.
technical.precauciones_es: Evitar el jalón tras nuca si hay limitación de movilidad de hombro.
technical.precauciones_en: Avoid behind-the-neck pulldowns with limited shoulder mobility.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley. Make sure that you adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.
2. Grab the bar with the palms facing forward using the prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than shoulder width. For a medium grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to your shoulder width and for a close grip at a distance smaller than your shoulder width.
3. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.
4. As you breathe out, bring the bar down until it touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work except for holding the bar; therefore do not try to pull down the bar using the forearms.
5. After a second at the contracted position squeezing your shoulder blades together, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched. Inhale during this portion of the movement.
6. Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

1. Sit down on a pull-down machine with a wide bar attached to the top pulley. Make sure that you adjust the knee pad of the machine to fit your height. These pads will prevent your body from being raised by the resistance attached to the bar.
2. Grab the bar with the palms facing forward using the prescribed grip. Note on grips: For a wide grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than your shoulder width. For a medium grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to your shoulder width and for a close grip at a distance smaller than your shoulder width.
3. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso and head forward. Think of an imaginary line from the center of the bar down to the back of your neck. This is your starting position.
4. As you breathe out, bring the bar down until it touches the back of your neck by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work except for holding the bar; therefore do not try to pull down the bar using the forearms.
5. After a second on the contracted position squeezing your shoulder blades together, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched. Inhale during this portion of the movement.
6. Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

1. Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using a wide grip.
2. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar, bring your torso forward and head so that there is an imaginary line from the pull-up bar to the back of your neck. This is your starting position.
3. Pull your torso up until the bar is near the back of your neck. To do this, draw the shoulders and upper arms down and back while slightly leaning your head forward. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
4. After a second on the contracted position, start to inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.
5. Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

technical.nombre_es: Curl de pie con barra, agarre abierto
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Stand up with your torso upright while holding a barbell at the wide outer handle. The palm of your hands should be facing forward. The elbows should be close to the torso. This will be your starting position.
2. While holding the upper arms stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Tip: Only the forearms should move.
3. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second and squeeze the biceps hard.
4. Slowly begin to bring the bar back to starting position as your breathe in.
5. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

1. This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
2. Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.
3. Step away from the rack and position your legs using a wider-than-shoulder-width stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance, and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position.
4. Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
5. Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

technical.nombre_es: Peso muerto piernas rígidas, piernas abiertas
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Begin with a barbell loaded on the floor. Adopt a wide stance, and then bend at the hips to grab the bar. Your hips should be as far back as possible, and your legs nearly straight. Keep your back straight, and your head and chest up. This will be your starting position.
2. Begin the movement be engaging the hips, driving them forward as you allow the arms to hang straight. Continue until you are standing straight up, and then slowly return the weight to the starting position. For successive reps, the weight need not touch the floor.

1. Hang from a pull-up bar using a pronated grip. Your arms and legs should be extended. This will be your starting position.
2. Begin by quickly raising one knee as high as you can. Do not swing your body or your legs. 3
3. Immediately reverse the motion, returning that leg to the starting position. Simultaneously raise the opposite knee as high as possible.
4. Continue alternating between legs until the set is complete.

1. Lie on your back with your arms extended out to the sides and your legs straight. This will be your starting position.
2. Lift one leg and quickly cross it over your body, attempting to touch the ground near the opposite hand.
3. Return to the starting position, and repeat with the opposite leg. Continue to alternate for 10-20 repetitions.

1. This is a three-part stretch. Begin by lunging forward, with your front foot flat on the ground and on the toes of your back foot. With your knees bent, squat down until your knee is almost touching the ground. Keep your torso erect, and hold this position for 10-20 seconds.
2. Now, place the arm on the same side as your front leg on the ground, with the elbow next to the foot. Your other hand should be placed on the ground, parallel to your lead leg, to help support you during this portion of the stretch.
3. After 10-20 seconds, place your hands on either side of your front foot. Raise the toes of the front foot off of the ground, and straighten your leg. You may need to reposition your rear leg to do so. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then repeat the entire sequence for the other side.

1. Start by standing straight with your feet being shoulder width apart from each other. Elevate your arms to the side of you until they are fully extended and parallel to the floor at a height that is evenly aligned with your shoulders. Tip: Your torso and arms should form the letter "T: Your palms should be facing down. This is the starting position.
2. Keeping your entire body stationary except for the wrists, begin to rotate both wrists forward in a circular motion. Tip: Pretend that you are trying to draw circles by using your hands as the brush. Breathe normally as you perform this exercise.
3. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

technical.ejecucion_es: De pie con los brazos extendidos al frente sujetando el rodillo, del que cuelga un peso con una cuerda. Enrollar la cuerda girando las muñecas alternativamente hasta subir el peso y desenrollar controlando.
technical.ejecucion_en: Stand with the arms straight in front holding the roller, from which a weight hangs on a cord. Roll the cord up by alternately turning the wrists until the weight reaches the top, then unroll under control.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Hacerlo en ambos sentidos para trabajar flexores y extensores.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Roll in both directions to work the flexors and extensors.
technical.errores_es: Bajar los brazos; dejar caer el peso.
technical.errores_en: Dropping the arms; letting the weight fall.
technical.precauciones_en: None specific.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. To begin, stand straight up grabbing a wrist roller using a pronated grip (palms facing down). Your feet should be shoulder width apart.
2. Slowly lift both arms until they are fully extended and parallel to the floor in front of you. Note: Make sure the rope is not wrapped around the roller. Your entire body should be stationary except for the forearms. This is the starting position.
3. Rotate one wrist at a time in an upward motion to bring the weight up to the bar by rolling the rope around the roller.
4. Once the weight has reached the bar, slowly begin to lower the weight back down by rotating the wrist in a downward motion until the weight reaches the starting position.
5. Repeat for the prescribed amount of repetitions in your program.

technical.nombre_es: Rotaciones de muñeca con barra recta
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing down; hands spaced about shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
2. Alternating between each of your hands, perform the movement by extending the wrist as though you were rolling up a newspaper. Continue alternating back and forth until failure.
3. Reverse the motion by flexing the wrist, rolling the opposite direction. Continue the alternating motion until failure.

1. The yoke is usually done with a yoke apparatus, but is sometimes seen with refrigerators or other heavy objects.
2. Begin by racking the apparatus across the back of the shoulders. With your head looking forward and back arched, lift the yoke by driving through the heels.
3. Begin walking as quickly as possible using short, quick steps. You may hold the side posts of the yoke to help steady it and hold it in position. Continue for the given distance as fast as possible, usually 75-100 feet.

technical.ejecucion_es: Sentadilla con la barra sujeta en el pliegue de los codos, delante del cuerpo.
technical.ejecucion_en: A squat with the bar held in the crook of the elbows in front of the body.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Exige mucho a la espalda alta y al core. Usar almohadilla o manga si la barra molesta.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Very demanding on the upper back and core. Use a pad or sleeve if the bar is uncomfortable.
technical.errores_es: Redondear la espalda alta; dejar caer los codos.
technical.errores_en: Rounding the upper back; letting the elbows drop.
technical.precauciones_es: Molesto para los codos al principio; cargas moderadas.
technical.precauciones_en: Uncomfortable on the elbows at first; moderate loads.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. The correct height should be anywhere above the waist but below the chest. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, lock your hands together and place the bar on top of your arms in between the forearm and upper arm.
2. Lift the bar up so that it is resting on top of your forearms. If you are holding the bar properly, it should look as if you have your arms crossed but with a bar running across them.
3. Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section).
4. Begin to lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
5. Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the ball of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

technical.ejecucion_es: De pie con una mancuerna en cada mano y palmas hacia delante. Flexionar los codos hasta arriba, girar las palmas hacia abajo y bajar en pronación; abajo, volver a girar a supinación.
technical.ejecucion_en: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward. Curl up, rotate the palms down at the top and lower in a pronated grip; at the bottom, rotate back to supination.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Combina bíceps (subida) y braquiorradial/extensores (bajada). Bajar lento.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Combines biceps (lifting) and brachioradialis/forearm extensors (lowering). Lower slowly.
technical.errores_es: Girar las muñecas a mitad de recorrido; balancear el cuerpo.
technical.errores_en: Rotating the wrists mid-range; swinging the body.
technical.precauciones_es: La bajada en pronación limita la carga: usar mancuernas ligeras.
technical.precauciones_en: The pronated lowering limits the load: use light dumbbells.
technical.instrucciones_fuente_en:
1. Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length. The elbows should be close to the torso.
2. Make sure the palms of the hands are facing each other. This will be your starting position.
3. While holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Your wrist should rotate so that you have a supinated (palms up) grip. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
4. Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the biceps.
5. Now during the contracted position, rotate your wrist until you now have a pronated (palms facing down) grip with the thumb at a higher position than the pinky.
6. Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back down using the pronated grip.
7. As the dumbbells close your thighs, start rotating the wrist so that you go back to a neutral (palms facing your body) grip.
8. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

1. Grab a dumbbell in each hand and place your upper arms on top of the preacher bench or the incline bench. The dumbbells should be held at shoulder height and the elbows should be flexed. Hold the dumbbells with the palms of your hands facing down. This will be your starting position.
2. As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells keeping the palms down until your upper arm is extended and your biceps are fully stretched.
3. Now rotate your wrists once you are at the bottom of the movement so that the palms of the hands are facing up.
4. As you exhale, use your biceps to curl the weights up until they are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder height. Again, remember that to ensure full contraction you need to bring that small finger higher than the thumb.
5. Squeeze the biceps hard for a second at the contracted position and rotate your wrists so that the palms are facing down again.
6. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

technical.ejecucion_es: Barra en posición de rack frontal. Sentadilla frontal completa y, sin pausa, extensión explosiva de cadera y rodillas que impulsa la barra hasta bloquearla por encima de la cabeza. Bajar la barra al rack frontal y enlazar la siguiente repetición.
technical.ejecucion_en: Bar in the front rack position. A full front squat and, without pausing, an explosive hip and knee extension that drives the bar to lockout overhead. Lower the bar to the front rack and go into the next rep.
technical.recomendaciones_es: La barra se impulsa con las piernas; los brazos solo terminan. Respirar arriba, no abajo.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The legs drive the bar; the arms only finish it. Breathe at the top, not at the bottom.
technical.errores_es: Codos caídos en el rack frontal; empujar con los brazos antes de terminar la extensión de cadera; no bloquear codos arriba; talones que se levantan en la sentadilla.
technical.errores_en: Elbows dropping in the front rack; pressing before the hips finish extending; not locking the elbows; heels lifting in the squat.
technical.precauciones_es: Exige movilidad de tobillo, cadera, hombro y muñeca para el rack frontal y la posición overhead. Escalar carga antes que rango.
technical.precauciones_en: Requires ankle, hip, shoulder and wrist mobility for the front rack and overhead positions. Scale load before range.

technical.ejecucion_es: Cargada desde el suelo recibiendo en sentadilla profunda y, desde esa posición, ponerse de pie de forma continua para ejecutar el thruster hasta bloquear arriba.
technical.ejecucion_en: A clean from the floor caught in a deep squat and, from there, a continuous stand-up into a thruster to lockout.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Usar el rebote de la sentadilla de la cargada para impulsar el thruster.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Use the bounce out of the clean's squat to drive the thruster.
technical.errores_es: Recepción alta seguida de una segunda sentadilla; espalda redondeada en el tirón; perder el rack frontal.
technical.errores_en: Catching high then squatting again; rounding the back in the pull; losing the front rack.
technical.precauciones_es: Movimiento técnico de alta demanda; dominar por separado la cargada y el thruster.
technical.precauciones_en: A demanding technical movement; master the clean and thruster separately first.

technical.ejecucion_es: Desde la barra a medio muslo, bisagra de cadera y extensión explosiva de cadera, rodillas y tobillos; tirón con los codos altos y recepción en rack frontal por encima de la paralela.
technical.ejecucion_en: From the bar at mid-thigh, hinge and extend the hips, knees and ankles explosively; pull with high elbows and catch in the front rack above parallel.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Habitual en WODs por su rapidez de enlace.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Common in WODs because reps link quickly.
technical.errores_es: Tirar con los brazos antes de extender; saltar hacia delante; recibir con los codos bajos.
technical.errores_en: Pulling with the arms before extending; jumping forward; catching with low elbows.
technical.precauciones_es: Mantener la espalda neutra en la bisagra. Carga moderada si se encadena en volumen.
technical.precauciones_en: Keep the back neutral in the hinge. Moderate load when cycling at volume.

technical.ejecucion_es: Barra en rack frontal. Flexión breve de rodillas (dip), extensión explosiva y, mientras la barra sube, segunda flexión de rodillas para recibirla con los brazos bloqueados; terminar de pie.
technical.ejecucion_en: Bar in the front rack. A short knee dip, explosive drive and, as the bar rises, a second knee bend to receive it with locked arms; finish standing.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Meterse bajo la barra en lugar de empujarla hasta arriba. Permite más carga que el push press.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Drive yourself under the bar rather than pressing it all the way. Allows more load than the push press.
technical.errores_es: Dip con el torso inclinado hacia delante; recibir con los codos flexionados; pies que no recuperan su posición.
technical.errores_en: Leaning forward in the dip; receiving with bent elbows; feet not returning to position.
technical.precauciones_es: Bloquear la barra sobre la línea media del pie; hombros estables en la recepción.
technical.precauciones_en: Lock the bar over mid-foot; keep the shoulders stable in the catch.

technical.nombre_es: Hombro a por encima de la cabeza (S2OH)
technical.ejecucion_es: Movimiento genérico de CrossFit: llevar la barra desde el rack frontal hasta bloqueo overhead con cualquier técnica válida (press, push press, push jerk o split jerk). La repetición cuenta con caderas, rodillas y codos extendidos arriba.
technical.ejecucion_en: A generic CrossFit movement: take the bar from the front rack to overhead lockout using any valid technique (press, push press, push jerk or split jerk). The rep counts with hips, knees and elbows extended at the top.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Con cargas ligeras, push press; con cargas altas, jerk.
technical.recomendaciones_en: With light loads use a push press; with heavy loads, a jerk.
technical.errores_es: No bloquear completamente; carga desplazada por delante de la cabeza.
technical.errores_en: Not locking out fully; the load ending up in front of the head.
technical.precauciones_es: En el registro conviene anotar la técnica empleada si se quiere comparar entre sesiones.
technical.precauciones_en: Log the technique used if you want to compare across sessions.

technical.nombre_es: Suelo a por encima de la cabeza (G2OH)
technical.ejecucion_es: Movimiento genérico de CrossFit: llevar la carga del suelo a bloqueo overhead con cualquier técnica válida (arrancada, o cargada más jerk).
technical.ejecucion_en: A generic CrossFit movement: take the load from the floor to overhead lockout with any valid technique (snatch, or clean plus jerk).
technical.recomendaciones_es: Con discos de bumper permite soltar la barra desde arriba. Elegir la técnica según carga y fatiga.
technical.recomendaciones_en: With bumper plates the bar can be dropped from overhead. Choose the technique by load and fatigue.
technical.errores_es: Perder la espalda neutra al levantar del suelo; no bloquear arriba.
technical.errores_en: Losing a neutral back off the floor; not locking out overhead.
technical.precauciones_es: Anotar la técnica empleada; en carga alta priorizar la técnica olímpica dominada.
technical.precauciones_en: Log the technique used; with heavy loads favour the Olympic technique you have mastered.

technical.ejecucion_es: Postura sumo con agarre cerrado. Peso muerto sumo explosivo que continúa en un tirón alto llevando la barra bajo la barbilla con los codos altos; descenso controlado.
technical.ejecucion_en: Wide sumo stance with a narrow grip. An explosive sumo deadlift that continues into a high pull, bringing the bar under the chin with the elbows high; lower under control.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Secuencia: piernas, cadera y, al final, brazos. En WODs largos, mantener un ritmo constante.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Sequence: legs, hips and finally arms. In long WODs keep a steady rhythm.
technical.errores_es: Tirar con los brazos antes de extender la cadera; codos por debajo de las manos; hiperextensión lumbar.
technical.errores_en: Pulling with the arms before extending the hips; elbows below the hands; lumbar hyperextension.
technical.precauciones_es: Puede irritar el hombro en volumen alto; evitar si hay pinzamiento subacromial.
technical.precauciones_en: Can irritate the shoulder at high volume; avoid with subacromial impingement.

technical.ejecucion_es: Pie trasero apoyado en un banco, pie delantero adelantado. Descender flexionando la rodilla delantera hasta que el muslo quede cerca de la horizontal y subir empujando con el pie delantero. Admite barra, mancuernas o kettlebells.
technical.ejecucion_en: Rear foot on a bench, front foot forward. Lower by bending the front knee until the thigh is near horizontal, then drive up through the front foot. Can be done with a barbell, dumbbells or kettlebells.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Inclinación del tronco hacia delante para más glúteo; tronco erguido para más cuádriceps.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Lean forward for more glutes; stay upright for more quads.
technical.errores_es: Pie delantero demasiado cerca del banco; rodilla que colapsa hacia dentro; impulsarse con la pierna trasera.
technical.errores_en: Front foot too close to the bench; knee caving in; pushing off the back leg.
technical.precauciones_es: Exige equilibrio; empezar sin carga. Registrar cada pierna por separado.
technical.precauciones_en: Requires balance; start unloaded. Log each leg separately.

technical.nombre_es: Zancada con barra en rack frontal
technical.ejecucion_es: Barra en rack frontal; zancada alterna adelante o caminando hasta tocar ligeramente el suelo con la rodilla trasera, manteniendo el torso erguido.
technical.ejecucion_en: Bar in the front rack; alternating forward or walking lunges until the back knee lightly touches the floor, keeping the torso upright.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Codos altos durante todo el recorrido.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Keep the elbows high throughout.
technical.errores_es: Torso inclinado; codos caídos; paso demasiado corto.
technical.errores_en: Torso leaning; elbows dropping; step too short.
technical.precauciones_es: Controlar el contacto de la rodilla con el suelo.
technical.precauciones_en: Control the knee contact with the floor.

technical.nombre_es: Zancadas caminando con carga por encima de la cabeza
technical.ejecucion_es: Carga (disco, barra o mancuerna) bloqueada por encima de la cabeza; zancadas caminando alternas con la rodilla trasera rozando el suelo y los brazos bloqueados.
technical.ejecucion_en: Load (plate, barbell or dumbbell) locked out overhead; alternating walking lunges with the back knee brushing the floor and the arms locked.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Costillas abajo y glúteos activos para no arquear la espalda.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Ribs down and glutes engaged to avoid arching the back.
technical.errores_es: Codos que se flexionan; costillas abiertas e hiperextensión lumbar; carga por delante de la cabeza.
technical.errores_en: Elbows bending; ribs flaring with lumbar hyperextension; load drifting in front of the head.
technical.precauciones_es: Requiere estabilidad de hombro; escalar con carga ligera o con la carga en rack frontal.
technical.precauciones_en: Requires shoulder stability; scale with a light load or by holding it in the front rack.

technical.ejecucion_es: Mancuerna entre los pies. Bisagra de cadera, extensión explosiva y tirón continuo hasta bloquear la mancuerna por encima de la cabeza en un solo movimiento. Cambiar de mano según el estándar.
technical.ejecucion_en: Dumbbell between the feet. Hinge, extend explosively and pull continuously to lock the dumbbell out overhead in one movement. Switch hands according to the standard.
technical.recomendaciones_es: La mancuerna sube pegada al cuerpo; la cadera hace el trabajo.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Keep the dumbbell close to the body; the hips do the work.
technical.errores_es: Tirar sólo con el brazo; espalda redondeada al coger la mancuerna del suelo; no bloquear arriba.
technical.errores_en: Pulling with the arm only; rounding the back when picking it up; not locking out overhead.
technical.precauciones_es: En volumen alto vigilar la fatiga lumbar. Anotar la mano si se hace sin alternar.
technical.precauciones_en: Watch lower-back fatigue at high volume. Log the hand if not alternating.

technical.ejecucion_es: Mancuernas sobre los hombros. Sentadilla completa y extensión explosiva que impulsa las mancuernas hasta bloquearlas por encima de la cabeza.
technical.ejecucion_en: Dumbbells on the shoulders. A full squat and an explosive extension that drives the dumbbells to lockout overhead.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Una cabeza de cada mancuerna apoyada en el hombro durante la sentadilla.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Rest one head of each dumbbell on the shoulder during the squat.
technical.errores_es: Empujar antes de terminar la extensión; codos que caen en la sentadilla.
technical.errores_en: Pressing before the extension finishes; elbows dropping in the squat.
technical.precauciones_en: Scale load before range.

technical.nombre_es: Cargada colgante y jerk con mancuerna
technical.ejecucion_es: Mancuerna a la altura de la rodilla; cargada al hombro con extensión de cadera y, desde el hombro, dip y jerk hasta bloquear. Una o dos mancuernas según el estándar.
technical.ejecucion_en: Dumbbell at knee height; clean it to the shoulder with hip extension and, from the shoulder, dip and jerk to lockout. One or two dumbbells depending on the standard.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Apoyar la mancuerna en el hombro antes del jerk para estabilizarla.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Rest the dumbbell on the shoulder before the jerk to stabilise it.
technical.errores_es: Rotar el tronco al cargar; bloquear con el codo flexionado.
technical.errores_en: Rotating the torso on the clean; locking out with a bent elbow.
technical.precauciones_es: Indicar en el registro si es a una o dos mancuernas.
technical.precauciones_en: Log whether one or two dumbbells were used.

technical.ejecucion_es: Con dos mancuernas en el suelo: burpee con el pecho al suelo apoyando las manos en las mancuernas; al subir, llevar ambas mancuernas desde el suelo hasta por encima de la cabeza en un solo movimiento tipo swing-arrancada.
technical.ejecucion_en: With two dumbbells on the floor: a chest-to-floor burpee with the hands on the dumbbells; on standing, swing both dumbbells from the floor to overhead in one snatch-like movement.
technical.recomendaciones_es: El impulso viene de la extensión de cadera, como en un swing. Mantener un ritmo sostenible.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The drive comes from hip extension, as in a swing. Keep a sustainable pace.
technical.errores_es: Espalda redondeada al levantar; brazos que tiran sin extensión de cadera.
technical.errores_en: Rounded back when lifting; arms pulling without hip extension.
technical.precauciones_es: Muy exigente a nivel cardiorrespiratorio y lumbar; escalar carga.
technical.precauciones_en: Very demanding on the cardiovascular system and lower back; scale the load.

technical.ejecucion_es: Kettlebell a dos manos. Bisagra de cadera llevando la kettlebell entre las piernas y extensión explosiva de cadera que la proyecta hasta la altura de los ojos con los brazos relajados.
technical.ejecucion_en: Kettlebell in both hands. Hinge to hike the bell between the legs and extend the hips explosively to project it to eye level with relaxed arms.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Al subir, glúteos apretados y cuerpo en plancha de pie. Es la base de todo el trabajo con kettlebell.
technical.recomendaciones_en: At the top, squeeze the glutes and hold a standing plank. The foundation of all kettlebell work.
technical.errores_es: Convertirlo en sentadilla; levantar con los hombros; hiperextender la zona lumbar arriba.
technical.errores_en: Turning it into a squat; lifting with the shoulders; hyperextending the lower back at the top.
technical.precauciones_es: Movimiento de bisagra: espalda neutra durante todo el recorrido.
technical.precauciones_en: A hinge movement: keep the back neutral throughout.

technical.ejecucion_es: Como el swing ruso, pero la kettlebell sube hasta quedar sobre la cabeza con los brazos extendidos y el fondo de la kettlebell apuntando al techo.
technical.ejecucion_en: Like the Russian swing, but the kettlebell travels all the way overhead with straight arms and its base pointing at the ceiling.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Es el estándar de CrossFit. Costillas abajo arriba.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The CrossFit standard. Keep the ribs down at the top.
technical.errores_es: Hiperextensión lumbar y costillas abiertas arriba; tirar con los brazos.
technical.errores_en: Lumbar hyperextension with flared ribs at the top; pulling with the arms.
technical.precauciones_es: Requiere flexión completa de hombro; si falta movilidad, hacer la versión rusa.
technical.precauciones_en: Requires full shoulder flexion; without it, use the Russian version.

technical.ejecucion_es: Colgado de la barra, balanceo controlado entre posición arqueada y hueca (kip) que genera impulso para llevar la barbilla por encima de la barra.
technical.ejecucion_en: Hanging from the bar, a controlled swing between arch and hollow positions (the kip) that generates momentum to get the chin over the bar.
technical.recomendaciones_es: El movimiento nace de la cadera y los hombros activos, no de patadas. Practicar el kip swing antes de unirlo a la dominada.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The movement comes from the hips and active shoulders, not from kicking. Practise the kip swing before linking it to the pull-up.
technical.errores_es: Balanceo desordenado sin activación escapular; bajar sin control.
technical.errores_en: A messy swing without scapular engagement; dropping uncontrolled.
technical.precauciones_es: Requiere fuerza previa en dominada estricta (al menos 3-5) y hombros sanos.
technical.precauciones_en: Requires prior strict pull-up strength (at least 3-5) and healthy shoulders.

technical.ejecucion_es: Dominada cíclica con trayectoria circular continua del cuerpo, que enlaza repeticiones sin pausa.
technical.ejecucion_en: A cyclical pull-up with a continuous circular body path, linking reps without pause.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Es la forma más rápida de dominada, pero exige mucha coordinación: aprender antes el kipping.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The fastest pull-up style, but it requires a lot of coordination: learn kipping first.
technical.errores_es: Perder el ritmo; no pasar la barbilla.
technical.errores_en: Losing the rhythm; not getting the chin over the bar.
technical.precauciones_es: Alta carga para el hombro; dominar antes la dominada con kipping.
technical.precauciones_en: High shoulder load; master the kipping pull-up first.

technical.nombre_es: Dominada con pecho a la barra (C2B)
technical.ejecucion_es: Dominada (estricta, con kipping o butterfly) en la que el pecho, por debajo de la clavícula, debe contactar con la barra.
technical.ejecucion_en: A pull-up (strict, kipping or butterfly) in which the chest, below the collarbone, must touch the bar.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Empujar la barra hacia abajo con la cadera algo alejada para llegar con el pecho.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Drive the bar down with the hips slightly away from it to reach it with the chest.
technical.errores_es: Contacto con la barbilla o el cuello; no extender brazos abajo.
technical.errores_en: Contact with the chin or neck; not reaching straight arms at the bottom.
technical.precauciones_en: Log the style (strict, kipping, butterfly).

technical.ejecucion_es: Desde colgado, kip potente que lleva las caderas a la barra y transición por encima hasta apoyo con brazos extendidos.
technical.ejecucion_en: From a hang, a powerful kip drives the hips to the bar, followed by a transition over it into support with straight arms.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Empujar la barra hacia abajo con brazos casi extendidos al cerrar la cadera; la transición es rápida y con los codos hacia atrás.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Press the bar down with nearly straight arms as the hips close; the transition is fast with the elbows driving back.
technical.errores_es: Codos que no pasan; subir un brazo antes que el otro (chicken wing).
technical.errores_en: Elbows not getting over; one arm getting over before the other (chicken wing).
technical.precauciones_es: Movimiento avanzado; requiere dominadas C2B y fondos en barra sólidos.
technical.precauciones_en: An advanced movement; requires solid C2B pull-ups and straight-bar dips.

technical.ejecucion_es: En pino contra la pared, bajar la cabeza al suelo o al soporte, flexionar rodillas y extenderlas de forma explosiva coordinando la extensión de brazos.
technical.ejecucion_en: In a wall handstand, lower the head to the floor or pad, tuck the knees and extend them explosively while pressing the arms.
technical.recomendaciones_es: La patada y el empuje deben coincidir. Dominar antes la versión estricta.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The kick and the press must coincide. Master the strict version first.
technical.errores_es: Caer sobre la cabeza sin control; extender piernas tarde.
technical.errores_en: Dropping onto the head uncontrolled; kicking too late.
technical.precauciones_es: Riesgo cervical; usar soporte acolchado y dominar antes la versión estricta.
technical.precauciones_en: Neck risk; use a padded surface and master the strict version first.

technical.ejecucion_es: Desplazarse sobre las manos en equilibrio invertido, con el cuerpo alineado. El resultado se registra en metros o en tramos.
technical.ejecucion_en: Walk on the hands in an inverted balance with the body aligned. The result is logged in metres or segments.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Pasos cortos y rápidos, mirada entre las manos y abdomen activo.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Short, quick steps, eyes between the hands and core engaged.
technical.errores_es: Banana excesiva; pasos demasiado largos.
technical.errores_en: Excessive arch (banana back); steps that are too long.
technical.precauciones_es: Aprender la salida segura (voltereta o giro) antes de practicarlo.
technical.precauciones_en: Learn a safe bail (roll or pirouette) before practising.

technical.ejecucion_es: Desde prono con los pies junto a la pared, subir los pies por la pared mientras las manos se acercan hasta tocar la pared con el pecho; deshacer el recorrido.
technical.ejecucion_en: From lying face down with the feet against the wall, walk the feet up the wall while the hands walk in until the chest touches the wall; reverse the path.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Mantener el abdomen activo y evitar la banana. Útil como progresión hacia el pino.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Keep the core engaged and avoid a banana back. Useful as a handstand progression.
technical.errores_es: Hiperextensión lumbar; manos lejos de la pared.
technical.errores_en: Lumbar hyperextension; hands staying far from the wall.
technical.precauciones_es: Progresar la distancia a la pared.
technical.precauciones_en: Progress the distance to the wall.

technical.ejecucion_es: Sentadilla a una pierna completa con la otra pierna extendida al frente; subir sin apoyo.
technical.ejecucion_en: A full single-leg squat with the other leg extended in front; rise without support.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Progresiones: a un cajón, sujetándose a un soporte, con contrapeso al frente.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Progressions: to a box, holding a support, with a counterweight in front.
technical.errores_es: Talón que se levanta; rodilla que colapsa hacia dentro; rebote al fondo.
technical.errores_en: Heel lifting; knee caving in; bouncing at the bottom.
technical.precauciones_es: Requiere mucha movilidad de tobillo; escalar con cajón o apoyo.
technical.precauciones_en: Requires a lot of ankle mobility; scale with a box or support.

technical.ejecucion_es: Colgado de la barra, llevar ambos pies a contactar simultáneamente con la barra entre las manos; admite kipping.
technical.ejecucion_en: Hanging from the bar, bring both feet to touch the bar at the same time between the hands; kipping is allowed.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Con kipping: empujar la barra hacia abajo con brazos extendidos al subir los pies.
technical.recomendaciones_en: With a kip: press the bar down with straight arms as the feet rise.
technical.errores_es: Contactar con un solo pie; balanceo sin control.
technical.errores_en: Touching with one foot only; uncontrolled swinging.
technical.precauciones_es: Exige agarre; puede irritar los hombros en volumen alto.
technical.precauciones_en: Demands grip; can irritate the shoulders at high volume.

technical.ejecucion_es: Colgado de la barra, elevar las rodillas hasta contactar con los codos.
technical.ejecucion_en: Hanging from the bar, raise the knees until they touch the elbows.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Progresión habitual hacia toes-to-bar.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The usual progression toward toes-to-bar.
technical.errores_es: No llegar al contacto; balanceo descontrolado.
technical.errores_en: Not making contact; uncontrolled swinging.
technical.precauciones_es: Exige agarre; con molestias de hombro, reducir el volumen.
technical.precauciones_en: Demands grip; with shoulder discomfort, reduce the volume.

technical.ejecucion_es: Sentado en el GHD con los pies sujetos, descender el tronco hasta tocar el suelo detrás con las manos y subir hasta tocar los pies.
technical.ejecucion_en: Seated on the GHD with the feet anchored, lower the torso until the hands touch the floor behind, then sit up to touch the feet.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Empezar con rango parcial (hasta la horizontal) y pocas repeticiones.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Start with a partial range (to horizontal) and few reps.
technical.errores_es: Rango excesivo de inicio sin adaptación.
technical.errores_en: Using excessive range before adapting.
technical.precauciones_es: Muy alta demanda sobre flexores de cadera; empezar con pocas repeticiones (asociado a rabdomiólisis en novatos con volumen alto).
technical.precauciones_en: Very high demand on the hip flexors; start with few reps (linked to rhabdomyolysis in beginners doing high volume).

technical.ejecucion_es: Tumbado con AbMat bajo la zona lumbar y plantas de los pies juntas, tocar el suelo por detrás de la cabeza y subir a tocar los pies.
technical.ejecucion_en: Lying with an AbMat under the lower back and the soles of the feet together, touch the floor behind the head and sit up to touch the feet.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Estándar de CrossFit; el AbMat amplía el recorrido y protege la zona lumbar.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The CrossFit standard; the AbMat extends the range and supports the lower back.
technical.errores_es: Tirar del cuello; impulsarse con los brazos.
technical.errores_en: Pulling on the neck; throwing the arms.
technical.precauciones_en: None specific.

technical.ejecucion_es: Posición hueca (zona lumbar pegada al suelo, brazos y piernas extendidos y elevados) y balanceo adelante-atrás sin perderla.
technical.ejecucion_en: Hollow position (lower back pressed to the floor, arms and legs straight and raised) and rock back and forth without losing it.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Base de los movimientos gimnásticos con kipping.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The foundation of kipping gymnastics movements.
technical.errores_es: Separar la zona lumbar del suelo; flexionar las piernas.
technical.errores_en: Lifting the lower back; bending the legs.
technical.precauciones_es: Escalar con rodillas flexionadas o brazos a los lados.
technical.precauciones_en: Scale with bent knees or the arms by the sides.

technical.ejecucion_es: Mantener la posición hueca durante el tiempo establecido. El resultado se registra en segundos.
technical.ejecucion_en: Hold the hollow position for the set time. Logged in seconds.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Cuanto más bajos los brazos y piernas, más difícil, siempre sin despegar la zona lumbar.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The lower the arms and legs, the harder, always without the lower back lifting.
technical.errores_es: Arqueo lumbar.
technical.errores_en: Arching the lower back.
technical.precauciones_en: Scale with bent knees.

technical.ejecucion_es: Apoyado en paralelas, anillas o suelo con brazos extendidos, mantener las piernas extendidas a la horizontal. Se registra en segundos.
technical.ejecucion_en: Supported on parallel bars, rings or the floor with straight arms, hold the legs straight at horizontal. Logged in seconds.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Hombros deprimidos y piernas juntas con las puntas estiradas.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Shoulders depressed and legs together with pointed toes.
technical.errores_es: Hombros elevados; rodillas flexionadas.
technical.errores_en: Shoulders shrugged; bent knees.
technical.precauciones_es: Escalar con una pierna o rodillas recogidas.
technical.precauciones_en: Scale with one leg or tucked knees.

technical.ejecucion_es: Desde tumbado, elevar simultáneamente tronco y piernas extendidas hasta tocar los pies con las manos.
technical.ejecucion_en: From lying, raise the torso and straight legs at the same time until the hands touch the feet.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Similar al sit-up navaja; buena prueba de control del core.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Similar to the jackknife sit-up; a good test of core control.
technical.errores_es: Impulso excesivo; piernas flexionadas.
technical.errores_en: Excessive momentum; bent legs.
technical.precauciones_en: None specific.

technical.ejecucion_es: Colgado de las anillas con el cuerpo recto y los pies en el suelo. Tirar hasta llevar el pecho a las manos y bajar hasta extender los brazos.
technical.ejecucion_en: Hang from the rings with the body straight and the feet on the floor. Pull until the chest reaches the hands, then lower to straight arms.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Cuanto más horizontal el cuerpo, más difícil. Rotar las palmas hacia dentro al subir.
technical.recomendaciones_en: The more horizontal the body, the harder it is. Turn the palms in as you pull.
technical.errores_es: Cadera caída; no retraer escápulas; tirar con el cuello adelantado.
technical.errores_en: Sagging hips; not retracting the shoulder blades; pulling with the head forward.
technical.precauciones_es: La inclinación del cuerpo regula la dificultad; anotarla si se quiere comparar.
technical.precauciones_en: Body angle sets the difficulty; note it for comparisons.

technical.ejecucion_es: Con falso agarre, dominada estricta hasta las anillas, transición y fondo hasta brazos extendidos, sin impulso de piernas.
technical.ejecucion_en: With a false grip, a strict pull-up to the rings, a transition and a dip to straight arms, with no leg drive.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Practicar transiciones en anillas bajas con pies apoyados antes de intentarlo colgado.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Practise transitions on low rings with the feet down before attempting it from a hang.
technical.errores_es: Perder el falso agarre; transición con un brazo antes que otro.
technical.errores_en: Losing the false grip; transitioning one arm before the other.
technical.precauciones_es: Muy exigente para codos y hombros.
technical.precauciones_en: Very demanding on the elbows and shoulders.

technical.ejecucion_es: Subir la cuerda únicamente con los brazos, mano sobre mano.
technical.ejecucion_en: Climb the rope using only the arms, hand over hand.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Mantener las piernas juntas en L o colgando para evitar el balanceo.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Keep the legs together in an L or hanging to avoid swinging.
technical.errores_es: Bajar dejándose caer (quemaduras y lesiones).
technical.errores_en: Sliding down (burns and injuries).
technical.precauciones_en: Always descend under control; use a mat.

technical.ejecucion_es: Subir el pegboard insertando alternativamente las clavijas en los agujeros superiores, solo con los brazos.
technical.ejecucion_en: Climb the pegboard by alternately inserting the pegs into higher holes, using only the arms.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Mantener los brazos semiflexionados y el core activo. Progresar con trepa de cuerda sin piernas y dominadas a un brazo asistidas.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Keep the arms slightly bent and the core engaged. Progress with legless rope climbs and assisted one-arm pull-ups.
technical.errores_es: Perder la clavija al bajar; ir con los brazos completamente extendidos.
technical.errores_en: Losing a peg on the way down; hanging on fully straight arms.
technical.precauciones_en: Descend under control; use a crash mat below.

technical.ejecucion_es: Flexión en la que, al llegar abajo, el pecho apoya en el suelo y las manos se despegan un instante antes de volver a apoyarlas y empujar hasta extender los brazos.
technical.ejecucion_en: A push-up where, at the bottom, the chest rests on the floor and the hands lift off briefly before being replaced and pressing up to straight arms.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Garantiza el recorrido completo, por eso es estándar en competición. Subir en bloque, con el cuerpo rígido.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Guarantees full range of motion, which is why it is a competition standard. Rise as one unit with a rigid body.
technical.errores_es: Subir primero la cadera y luego el pecho (gusano); no despegar las manos.
technical.errores_en: Raising the hips first and then the chest (worming); not lifting the hands.
technical.precauciones_es: Mismas que la flexión estándar; escalar con rodillas apoyadas.
technical.precauciones_en: Same as the standard push-up; scale with the knees down.

technical.ejecucion_es: Desde de pie, agacharse y apoyar las manos en el suelo, saltar o dar un paso atrás hasta quedar tumbado con pecho y muslos en el suelo, empujar para volver a apoyo, recoger los pies bajo la cadera y saltar con una palmada por encima de la cabeza.
technical.ejecucion_en: From standing, squat down and place the hands on the floor, jump or step back until lying with chest and thighs on the floor, push back up, bring the feet under the hips and jump with a clap overhead.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Buscar un ritmo sostenible y repetible: en un WOD conviene más un ritmo constante que salir demasiado rápido.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Find a sustainable, repeatable pace: in a WOD a steady rhythm beats going out too fast.
technical.errores_es: Arquear la zona lumbar al bajar; no tocar el suelo con el pecho; no extender la cadera arriba.
technical.errores_en: Arching the lower back on the way down; not touching the chest to the floor; not reaching full hip extension at the top.
technical.precauciones_es: El volumen alto de impactos acumula carga en muñecas y tobillos; escalar con paso atrás en lugar de salto.
technical.precauciones_en: High volumes of impacts load the wrists and ankles; scale by stepping back instead of jumping.

technical.ejecucion_es: Burpee paralelo a la barra, con el pecho al suelo, y al levantarse salto a dos pies por encima de la barra; el siguiente burpee se hace al otro lado.
technical.ejecucion_en: Perform a burpee parallel to the barbell with the chest to the floor, then on standing jump over the bar with both feet; the next burpee is done on the other side.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Saltar lateralmente sin girarse ahorra tiempo y facilita mantener el ritmo.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Jumping sideways without turning saves time and helps keep the rhythm.
technical.errores_es: Saltar a un pie; burpee sin pecho al suelo; alejarse de la barra entre repeticiones.
technical.errores_en: Jumping off one foot; burpee without the chest to the floor; drifting away from the bar between reps.
technical.precauciones_es: Atención a tropezar con la barra con la fatiga.
technical.precauciones_en: Watch for tripping over the bar when fatigued.

technical.nombre_es: Burpee con salto por encima del cajón
technical.ejecucion_es: Burpee de frente al cajón y, al levantarse, saltar a dos pies sobre el cajón (o subir) y pasar al otro lado; el siguiente burpee se hace en ese lado.
technical.ejecucion_en: Perform a burpee facing the box and, on standing, jump with both feet onto the box (or step up) and cross to the other side; the next burpee is done on that side.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Con fatiga alta, subir y bajar andando ahorra energía y reduce el riesgo de golpearse.
technical.recomendaciones_en: When fatigue is high, stepping up and down saves energy and reduces the risk of hitting the box.
technical.errores_es: Saltar demasiado lejos del cajón; aterrizar con las rodillas hacia dentro; caer de espaldas al bajar.
technical.errores_en: Jumping from too far away; landing with the knees caving in; falling backwards on the way down.
technical.precauciones_es: Riesgo de golpe en la espinilla con la fatiga: usar cajón blando o escalar a step-over.
technical.precauciones_en: Risk of shin strikes as fatigue builds: use a soft box or scale to a step-over.

technical.ejecucion_es: Burpee bajo una barra de dominadas; al saltar, agarrarse y hacer una dominada hasta pasar la barbilla por encima de la barra; soltarse y repetir.
technical.ejecucion_en: A burpee under a pull-up bar; on the jump, grab the bar and perform a pull-up until the chin clears it; drop down and repeat.
technical.recomendaciones_es: Usar el impulso del salto para enlazar con la dominada con kipping si el estándar lo permite.
technical.recomendaciones_en: Use the jump's momentum to link into a kipping pull-up if the standard allows it.
technical.errores_es: Barra demasiado alta para un salto seguro; caer sin control desde la barra.
technical.errores_en: Bar too high for a safe jump; dropping uncontrolled from the bar.
